scope: Offline learned ridge baseline, not NN, not motor policy. 0.2s appearance prediction conditional on single unclipped continuous fragments. Labels are future private retina; no host XY/IDs/range. Parameters fixed before evaluation; whole episodes split. OOD families reversal/occlusion/similar appear only in test. geometryOrHold uses stationary point and inferred size; otherwise unchanged appearance. Metrics do not qualify visibility prediction, identity, action value or life.
